context.body: Council and the second journey · Acts 16:6–15
context.label: Council and the second journey

observations.body: A Macedonian vision leads to Lydia. When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia. When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

payload.posture: Read Acts 16:6–15 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a Macedonian vision leads to Lydia. When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia. When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
